title: Hummingbird Sage
description: An elderly man with a beard and round glasses wears a dark patterned robe and wide-brimmed hat, gazing right. A large vibrant purple lotus blooms from his chest while a green hummingbird hovers beside his face, its beak near the flower.
prompt: Surreal portrait of an elderly wise man with round glasses and a wide-brimmed hat, wearing a dark patterned robe. A large vibrant purple lotus flower blooms from his chest. A green hummingbird hovers near his face with its beak touching the lotus. Swirling colorful smoke and glowing ribbons in magenta, teal, and green fill the cosmic background with stars and floating patterns, mystical and dreamlike atmosphere.
